param.label: Task
param.name: task
param.option: Mode I: Load Mad Blanks component main page
Mode II: Load Mad Blanks module in main content area
Mode III: View Mad Blanks records from given category
Mode IV: Load Mad Blanks URL manually specified below

param.label: Module to load (for Mode II only); the module's Menu Assignment must be set to appear for this menu item or for All menu items; any module position can be used; recommend that you use module position madblanks
param.name: moduleid
param.query: SELECT id,CONCAT(IF(id < 10, '# ', '#'), id, ', ', SUBSTRING(module, 15), ', ', IF(CHAR_LENGTH(title) > 30, CONCAT(SUBSTRING(title, 1, 30), '...'), title), ', ', position, ', ', IF(published,'Enabled','Disabled')) AS name FROM #__modules WHERE ( module = 'mod_madblanks_createsinglerecord' OR module = 'mod_madblanks_singlefieldinput' OR module = 'mod_madblanks_display' OR module = 'mod_madblanks_menu' ) ORDER BY ordering ASC

param.label: Mad Blanks category (for Mode II and Mode III); Mode II uses this setting with the Create Single Record module only)
param.name: categoryid
param.query: (SELECT 'none' AS id, '<none specified>' AS name) UNION (SELECT id,CONCAT(IF(id < 10, '# ', '#'), id, ': ', IF(CHAR_LENGTH(name) > 55, CONCAT(SUBSTRING(name, 1, 55), '...'), name), ', ', IF(published, 'Published', 'Unpublished')) FROM #__madblanks_categories ORDER BY ordering ASC)

param.name: startpage
param.label:
Specify any Mad Blanks URL to point this menu item to (for Mode IV only); DON'T INCLUDE THE PART OF THE URL HERE IN PURPLE: http://site_address/index.php?option=com_madblanks&Itemid=x where x is the Itemid (if available);
Example: To show multiple categories (for example, categories 1, 2, and 5) set this to &task=showmadblanks&category=1,2,5

param.name: select
param.label: SELECT (advanced option for Mode III and Mode IV): Override the SELECT statement used to view records (when task=showmadblanks in the URL); leave blank to use the default SELECT clause (rec.*, IF(rec.ordering,1,0) AS specialordering); use this parameter in conjunction with the ORDER BY parameter to allow for custom ordering

param.name: orderby
param.label:
ORDER BY (advanced option for Mode III and Mode IV): One field or a comma-separated list of fields from the Mad Blanks records (prefixed by rec.) or categories (prefixed by cat.) database tables to ORDER BY when showing a list of records on the front end (when task=showmadblanks in the URL); leave blank to use the default ordering;
Examples:
rec.date_entered

rec.date_entered DESC

rec.data_01,rec.data_02

rec.entered_by DESC,rec.scodata1 ASC,rec.data_10 DESC

cat.ordering ASC,rec.scodata1 ASC,rec.date_entered ASC,rec.scodata1 DESC
